auditor_unit_tests.detail: Focused D6 auditor unit suite completed before this audit step.

d5_artifact_download.detail: Workflow verified exact pinned GitHub Artifact metadata, digest, and downloaded byte size before invoking auditor.

docx_files.detail: Per-file DOCX parse, T2, §17.3 substance, OOXML directionality and resolution of every explicit Number Registry ID; full numeric-token lineage remains a separate acceptance test.

docx_number_registry_traceability.detail: Every explicit NR-/D2D- identifier in DOCX resolves against the pinned Number Registry/extension; this does not claim every numeric token is registry-backed or execute Test 176.

docx_rendering.detail: Each DOCX was rendered in a separate LibreOffice process with an isolated profile and 120-second timeout; both summaries must be 2–3 pages.

docx_176.detail: Test 176 requires complete numeric-token-to-Number-Registry lineage; scoped explicit-ID resolution and rendering do not execute that acceptance test.

This is scoped package evidence, not a claim that the separately numbered historical test suite was invoked.
